props.name: autoplay
props.description:
`true` enables autoplay at a default interval; a number sets the interval
in ms. Autoplay pauses while the user is dragging.

props.name: axisLock
props.description:
Only consume predominantly-horizontal gestures, releasing vertical drags to
the host scroll surface.

props.name: items
props.description:
Items array. When set, one `SwiperItem` is rendered per entry via the `item`
slot; otherwise the `default` slot is rendered as-is and should contain
manually-placed `<SwiperItem>` children.

props.name: itemWidth
props.description:
Width of each item in px. When omitted, the swiper measures its container
so slides follow viewport rotation.

props.name: loop
props.description: Navigate circularly: dragging/autoplay past the last item wraps around.

props.name: showIndicators
props.description: Show the fixed dot indicator strip. Opt-in.
